scripts.copy:assets: cp src/popup/popup.html src/popup/popup.css dist/ && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp img/icon*.png dist/icons/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:bg && npm run build:popup && npm run copy:assets
scripts.package: npm run verify && npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr "../tab-group-timer-$npm_package_version.zip" . && echo "packaged tab-group-timer-$npm_package_version.zip"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
